about.title: About Age Calculator
about.description: The Age Calculator determines age in years, months, days, hours, minutes, and seconds based on a birth date. It includes birthday countdown, zodiac reference, and age-related statistics for planning and general reference use. This tool is useful for document checks, birthday planning, or reviewing age on a selected date. It accounts for leap years and standard calendar differences.

faq.q: How does the age calculation work?
faq.a: The calculator applies standard calendar rules, including leap years and varying month lengths, to show age across different time units. Results should still be reviewed if you need them for formal or legal use.

faq.q: Can I calculate age for future dates?
faq.a: Yes, you can set any calculation date to see how old you'll be on a specific future date, which is useful for planning milestones, retirement, or other life events.
The calculator determines your Western zodiac sign based on your birth date, covering all 12 traditional astrological signs from Aries to Pisces with accurate date ranges.

faq.q: How does it handle leap year birthdays?
faq.a: For February 29th birthdays, the calculator properly handles leap years and uses February 28th in non-leap years for age calculations, ensuring accuracy across all years.
